meta.title: Kiln Yoga, small yoga studio in Peckham
meta.description: Fourteen mats above a bakery in Peckham. Slow flow, yin, a 4 week beginners course and pregnancy yoga on Saturday mornings.

rationale: Deep forest green with warm cream text and a single amber accent keeps the page close to the room itself: dark wood, window light, bread. A light serif at large size and a quiet statement hero give the unhurried tone, and the hand-drawn floor plan with exactly 14 mats says the thing no glossy yoga brand can say. Compositions are mostly text (prose columns, conversation, portrait) so the page reads like a letter from Mei.

props.statement: Fourteen mats on a wooden floor, above a bakery in Peckham. Slow flow, yin and pregnancy yoga, taught by Mei and two other teachers.
props.detail: Big windows, a warm room, and in the mornings the smell of bread coming up the stairs.

props.caption: The whole room, drawn to count: fourteen mats, big windows along one wall, the door in the corner.

items.name: Slow flow
items.description: Linked movement at a pace where you can feel each shape. Breath leads, the sequence follows. Good if you have practised before and want to stay close to the floor.

items.name: Yin
items.description: Few poses, held for a long time, mostly lying or sitting. Quiet and heavy in the best way. Nothing to get right.

items.name: Beginners course
items.description: Four weeks, the same small group each week. We learn the basic shapes and how to breathe through them, so that you can walk into any class afterwards.

items.name: Pregnancy yoga
items.description: Saturday mornings. Gentle movement, breathing and rest for pregnant women, in a room that has space for everyone.

pairs.ask: I have never done yoga. Will I be the only one?
pairs.answer: There are only 14 mats, so nobody disappears at the back. Tell Mei or the teacher on the day and they will keep an eye on you. The 4 week course is there if you would rather start with others who are new.
Something comfortable to move in. The floor is wooden and the room is warm, so you will not need layers. We have a few spare mats if you do not own one.
If you want to move, slow flow. If you want to stop, yin. If you are pregnant, Saturday mornings. If you are unsure, send a message and Mei will answer.

props.title: Mei
props.text: I teach most of the classes here, with two other teachers. I wanted a room where the class stays small enough that I can see everyone, so I stopped at fourteen mats. The floor is wood, the windows are big, and some mornings the whole studio smells of the bakery downstairs. Come and lie down for an hour.

photo.subject: Mei sitting on the wooden studio floor in morning light, relaxed, looking at the camera, a rolled mat beside her

props.title: Booking

items.name: Single class
items.description: Slow flow, yin or pregnancy yoga. Book the day before or on the day if there is a mat free.

items.name: Class pass
items.description: Ten classes, use them in any class you like.

items.name: Beginners course
items.description: Four weeks, one class a week, same group.

props.note: With 14 mats, classes fill up. Booking ahead is the easiest way to keep your place.

props.title: Find us
props.address: Kiln Yoga, above the bakery, Rye Lane, Peckham, London SE15
props.directions: Look for the bakery shopfront. The studio door is to the side, and the stairs go straight up to the room.
